title: Deep learning reconstruction combined with contrast enhancement boost improves image quality of low-contrast-dose ctpa: a prospective randomized study.
summary: In a 106-patient randomized CTPA study, deep-learning reconstruction and contrast-enhancement boost improved image quality under low contrast dose; their interaction increased CNR and the combined protocol scored highest on visibility. This is an imaging-quality result, not a patient-outcome benefit.
ai_technology: DLR reconstructs low-contrast-dose CTPA; CE-boost modifies contrast appearance
organization: Department of Radiology, The First Affiliated Hospital, Sun Yat-sen University, Guangzhou, China; Research Collaboration, Canon Medical Systems, Guangzhou, China

evidence.tested: In a 106-patient randomized CTPA study, deep-learning reconstruction and contrast-enhancement boost improved image quality under low contrast dose; their interaction increased CNR and the combined protocol scored highest on visibility. This is an imaging-quality result, not a patient-outcome benefit. Evaluation: Prospective randomized two-arm trial with factorial reconstruction comparison and blinded quantitative/qualitative assessments.
evidence.unknown: The randomized study measured image quality; improved patient outcomes from the imaging protocol were not established.
